newsitem.title: USA: Allegiance sees Q4, 1996 losses on charge.
newsitem.headline: Allegiance sees Q4, 1996 losses on charge.

text.p: Allegiance Corp said it expects to record a non-cash charge in the fourth quarter of $550 million that will cause the newly formed company to show losses for the quarter and 1996.
The charge will come on a change in Allegiance's accounting policy for assessing goodwill impairment, said the firm, recently spun off by Baxter International Inc.

The accounting change and write-down of goodwill will cut amortization expense by $4.7 million in the fourth quarter and by $18.9 million annually, raising net income on an ongoing basis by $18.9 million, or $0.34 per share, it said.
